pairs.target: xīn bǎn kàoqiáng shù hǎo shí , xiānqián jiǎn càiyè de rén yǐjīng zǒu le , píngtái biān huàn le gè tí kōngtǒng de nǚrén .
pairs.english: When the new board stood against the wall, the person previously picking leaves had already gone; beside the platform a woman carrying an empty bucket had taken his place.
pairs.hanzi: 新板靠墙竖好时，先前拣菜叶的人已经走了，平台边换了个提空桶的女人。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn shítái shàng de jiù bǎn , wèn hóngxiàn zěnme hái zài dìshàng .
pairs.english: She saw the old board on the ledge and asked why the red lines were still on the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 她看见石台上的旧板，问红线怎么还在地上。

pairs.target: lǎorén shuō jīnrì bù tiān , děi děng qú wù suǒ .
pairs.english: The old man said none would be added today; they had to wait for the Canal Office.
pairs.hanzi: 老人说今日不添，得等渠务所。

pairs.target: nǚrén bǎtǒng fàngxià , shēngyīn yíxià gāo le .
pairs.english: The woman put the bucket down, her voice suddenly rising.
pairs.hanzi: 女人把桶放下，声音一下高了。

pairs.target: tā shuō shàngyóu de càiqí quán zhǐzhe zhè dào xiàn , shuǐ luòdào zhèlǐ jiù gāi tíngfàng , nǎ néng shuō méi jiù méi .
pairs.english: She said all the upstream vegetable plots depended on this line: when the water fell to it, releases should stop; how could it simply disappear?
pairs.hanzi: 她说上游的菜畦全指着这道线，水落到这里就该停放，哪能说没就没。

pairs.target: niánqīng bānggōng zhèng bǎ dīngzi hán zài zuǐbiān , gǎnjǐn qǔchū lái , shuō tāmen zhǐ huàn bǎnzi .
pairs.english: The young helper had nails at his lips; he hurriedly took them out and said they were only replacing the board.
pairs.hanzi: 年轻帮工正把钉子含在嘴边，赶紧取出来，说他们只换板子。

pairs.target: " bǎnzi jiùshì gěi rén kàn de ! "
pairs.english: “The board is precisely for people to look at!”
pairs.hanzi: “板子就是给人看的！”

pairs.target: nǚrén shēnshǒu zhǐxiàng tǎ wéi de zhǐ , wèn tā chāoxiàlái le méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Pointing a hand at Tavi's paper, the woman asked whether he had copied them down.
pairs.hanzi: 女人伸手指向塔维的纸，问他抄下来了没有。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liǎngzhāng huà fēnkāi gěi tā kàn , xiān zhǐ cán bǎn , zài zhǐ jiù chāoběn .
pairs.english: He showed her the two drawings separately, first pointing to the broken board, then pointing to the old copy.
pairs.hanzi: 他把两张画分开给她看，先指残板，再指旧抄本。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu tīng wán , yǐjīng rènchū xiàbiān nàtiáo , wèn shìbushì yǒurén yào gǎihuíqù .
pairs.english: Without hearing him out, she had already recognised the lower line and asked whether someone meant to change it back.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有听完，已经认出下边那条，问是不是有人要改回去。

pairs.target: lǎorén shuō méi rén pèng zhá , bié chòng háizi chǎo .
pairs.english: The old man said nobody was touching the sluice, so don't shout at the child.
pairs.hanzi: 老人说没人碰闸，别冲孩子吵。

pairs.target: zhèhuà què ràng tā gèng nǎo , shuō měicì lái gè huì xiězì de , zuìhòu dàoxiàng tā bùjiǎnglǐ .
pairs.english: That only made her angrier; she said whenever someone who could write came, she ended up seeming the unreasonable one.
pairs.hanzi: 这话却让她更恼，说每次来个会写字的，最后倒像她不讲理。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ wǎng zìjǐ zhèbiān shōu le yìdiǎn , yòu tíngzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi drew the paper a little toward himself, then stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把纸往自己这边收了一点，又停住。

pairs.target: " wǒ xiě de shì tāmen yuánlái zài nǎér , búshì gāi yòng nǎyìtiáo . "
pairs.english: “I am writing where they originally were, not which one should be used.”
pairs.hanzi: “我写的是它们原来在哪儿，不是该用哪一条。”

pairs.target: tā pà tā méi tīng qīng , zhǐzhǐ zhǐ jiǎo de rìqī , méiyǒu zài duō shuō .
pairs.english: Afraid she hadn't heard clearly, he pointed to the date at the corner of the paper and said nothing more.
pairs.hanzi: 他怕她没听清，指指纸角的日期，没有再多说。

alignment.english: at the corner of the paper

pairs.target: nǚrén dītóu kàn le bànshǎng , zhōngyú bǎshǒu shōuhuí qù , réngjiù zhàn zài tǒng páng .
pairs.english: The woman lowered her head and looked for a long while, finally drew her hand back, and remained standing beside the bucket.
pairs.hanzi: 女人低头看了半晌，终于把手收回去，仍旧站在桶旁。

pairs.target: lùbiān chuánlái yìshēng duǎn xiào , yígè děng chuán de nánrén shuō , shàngtóu liúshuǐ dāngrán hǎo , xià tóu de chuán gē zhù le , cài yòu yào cóng shuí jiānshàng guò .
pairs.english: A short laugh came from the road; a man waiting for a boat said keeping water above was fine, but if boats below grounded, whose shoulders would carry the vegetables then?
pairs.hanzi: 路边传来一声短笑，一个等船的男人说，上头留水当然好，下头的船搁住了，菜又要从谁肩上过。

pairs.target: nǚrén rènde tā , jiào le tā de xìng , wèn qùnián tì nǎjiā de cài yùn guò yítàng .
pairs.english: The woman knew him, called him by his surname and asked whose vegetables he'd carried a load of last year.
pairs.hanzi: 女人认得他，叫了他的姓，问去年替哪家的菜运过一趟。

pairs.target: nánrén shuō kuāng shàng yòu bù xiě tián shì shuíjiā de , gěiqián biàn yùn .
pairs.english: The man said the baskets didn't say whose fields they came from; pay and he'd carry them.
pairs.hanzi: 男人说筐上又不写田是谁家的，给钱便运。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén yuè shuō yuè kuài , tǎ wéi tīngjiàn " xīn gōu "" gōngqián ", hòulái yòu shuōqǐ yíduàn tā cóngméi zǒuguò de pō .
pairs.english: They spoke faster and faster; Tavi caught “new ditch” and “wages,” then they mentioned a slope he had never walked.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人越说越快，塔维听见“新沟”“工钱”，后来又说起一段他从没走过的坡。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ běi ménwài nàxiē zhěngqí de càiqí , hūrán hěn xiǎng zhīdào tā shuō de shì qízhōng nǎyíkuài .
pairs.english: He remembered the neat plots outside the north gate and suddenly badly wanted to know which of them she meant.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起北门外那些整齐的菜畦，忽然很想知道她说的是其中哪一块。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiùshì zài zhèshí huílái de .
pairs.english: It was just then that Nerai returned.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾就是在这时回来的。

pairs.target: tā yánzhe píngtái wàicè zǒujìn , méiyǒu wǎng rén duī lǐ jǐ , xiān wèn yú shīfu hái quē bu quē shǒu .
pairs.english: She approached along the outside of the platform without squeezing into the crowd, first asking whether Master Yu still needed help.
pairs.hanzi: 她沿着平台外侧走近，没有往人堆里挤，先问虞师傅还缺不缺手。

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō shǒu gòu , quē yìzhāng méi bèi ná qù bāo yán de gàoshì .
pairs.english: Master Yu said she had enough hands, but lacked a notice that hadn't been used to wrap salt.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说手够，缺一张没被拿去包盐的告示。

pairs.target: lǎorén cháo tā dèngyǎn , tā què bǎ liǎngzhāng jìlù dìgěi nài lěi , zhǐ gěi tā kàn quēshī de shàng yuán .
pairs.english: The old man glared at her, but she handed Nerai the two records and showed her the missing upper edge.
pairs.hanzi: 老人朝她瞪眼，她却把两张记录递给奈蕾，指给她看缺失的上缘。

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn wán , zhī wèn zhǐ yào sòng qù nǎér , méiyǒu tì rènhé yìbiān shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Having read them, Nerai only asked where the papers were to go, without speaking for either side.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看完，只问纸要送去哪儿，没有替任何一边说话。

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō sòng qú wù suǒ , zìjǐ huíchéng jiù qù , dàn jīntiān bùnéng ràng xīn bǎn tì shuí zuòzhǔ .
pairs.english: Master Yu said the papers would go to the Canal Office; she would go there as soon as she returned to town, but today she could not let the new board decide for anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说送渠务所，自己回城就去，但今天不能让新板替谁作主。

pairs.target: tā qǐng nǚrén kànkàn gāng chāo hǎo de kèdù , shuōmíng gāodī yǔ jiù chāoběn zhúxiàng hé guò , shuǐchǐ de wèizhì yě méiyǒu dòng .
pairs.english: She asked the woman to look at the newly copied graduations, explaining that each height had been checked against the old copy and the gauge position had not moved either.
pairs.hanzi: 她请女人看看刚抄好的刻度，说明高低与旧抄本逐项核过，水尺的位置也没有动。

pairs.target: nǚrén wèn nà hóngxiàn zěnmebàn , tā biàn bǎ jiù bǎn zhǐ gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: The woman asked what would happen to the red lines, so she pointed the old board out to her.
pairs.hanzi: 女人问那红线怎么办，她便把旧板指给她看。

pairs.target: " liú zhe , bù cā , yě bú màochōng jīntiān chóngxīn dìng guò . "
pairs.english: “Keep them, don't erase them, and don't pretend they've been decided anew today.”
pairs.hanzi: “留着，不擦，也不冒充今天重新定过。”

pairs.target: tā jiào lǎorén tóng kàn yìzhāng duǎn zhǐ , shàngmiàn xiě yuán bǎn zàncún , hóngxiàn dài fùhé , mòwěi yóu tā shǔmíng .
pairs.english: She had the old man read a short note together with her; it said “original board retained, red lines awaiting review,” and she signed at the end.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫老人同看一张短纸，上面写原板暂存、红线待复核，末尾由她署名。

pairs.target: lǎorén niàn le yíbiàn , bǎ " zàncún " xiàbiān yā le kuài xiǎoshítou , méi zàishuō bùhǎo .
pairs.english: The old man read it once and weighted the bottom of “retained” with a small stone, without objecting again.
pairs.hanzi: 老人念了一遍，把“暂存”下边压了块小石头，没再说不好。

pairs.target: liǎnggè bānggōng bǎ xīn bǎn zhuāng huí yuánlái de gùdìng chù , yì rén fú , yì rén qiāo , duǎncù de chuí shēng zhōngyú gài guò le zhēnglùn .
pairs.english: The two helpers installed the new board at its original mounting points, one steadying, one hammering, until the brief hammer blows finally drowned out the argument.
pairs.hanzi: 两个帮工把新板装回原来的固定处，一人扶，一人敲，短促的锤声终于盖过了争论。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài qiángbiān yīcì niàn kèdù , niàn dào bā shí tíng le yíxià , chóngxīn kànguò zìjǐ de liǎngzhāng zhǐ , cái wǎng xià niàn .
pairs.english: Tavi read the graduations in order by the wall, paused once at eight, checked his own two sheets again, and only then continued reading.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在墙边依次念刻度，念到八时停了一下，重新看过自己的两张纸，才往下念。

pairs.target: yú shīfu tīng zhe , hé wán zuìhòu yì gé , shēnshǒu zài xīn bǎn shàng qīngpāi le yíxià .
pairs.english: Master Yu listened, checked the final division and reached to pat the new board lightly once.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅听着，核完最后一格，伸手在新板上轻拍了一下。

pairs.target: nǚrén réng bù mǎnyì , què yě wānyāo tíqǐ tǒng , wèn lǎorén jīnrì lún dào zìjǐ méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Still dissatisfied, the woman nevertheless bent to lift her bucket and asked the old man whether it was her turn today.
pairs.hanzi: 女人仍不满意，却也弯腰提起桶，问老人今日轮到自己没有。

pairs.target: lǎorén fānkāi lìng yìběn xiǎocè , shuō xiānqián nà jiā hái chà bàntǒng , jiào tā zuò yíhuìer .
pairs.english: The old man opened another booklet, saying the previous household still lacked half a bucket and asking her to sit a while.
pairs.hanzi: 老人翻开另一本小册，说先前那家还差半桶，叫她坐一会儿。

pairs.target: nà nánrén bǎ tā de kōngtǒng wǎng yīnchù nuó le nuó , zuǐlǐ què hái shuō , zuò yíhuìer kě bié yòu zuò dào tiānhēi .
pairs.english: The man shifted her empty bucket into the shade, yet still spoke: a short sit had better not turn into another wait until dark.
pairs.hanzi: 那男人把她的空桶往阴处挪了挪，嘴里却还说，坐一会儿可别又坐到天黑。

pairs.target: nǚrén huí le tā yíjù , tǎ wéi méi tīng quán , zhǐ tīngjiàn nài lěi zài pángbiān qīngqīng xiào le yìshēng .
pairs.english: The woman answered him with a remark; Tavi missed some of it, only hearing Nerai laugh softly beside him.
pairs.hanzi: 女人回了他一句，塔维没听全，只听见奈蕾在旁边轻轻笑了一声。
